overal.goal: Prepare the v0.4.0 release: bump the version in all package.json files and BOOF_VERSION, write CHANGELOG.md for changes since v0.3.0, and prepare the release workflow to build desktop installers after desktop-e2e is complete.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Planned after desktop-e2e: prepare the v0.4.0 version bump, changelog and desktop release.
v0.4.0 tagged without desktop-e2e by owner decision 2026-11-10; desktop unverified on real machines.

tests.strategy: CI green on the tag; release workflow produces installers.
